# DogsBay XML — Working with the agent

## Working with the agent

- [The agent, and what it may touch](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/overview.md): How the built-in agent and hosted agents differ, which tools they get, and the limits that apply before any change reaches a file.
- [Which agent to use](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/choosing.md): What the built-in agent is good at, what a hosted agent is good at, and why running both is a reasonable answer.
- [Reviewing an agent's changes](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/proposals.md): Agent edits to DITA files arrive as tracked changes. Accept them, reject them, or comment on them.
- [Using Claude Code, Codex or Gemini](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/hosted-agents.md): Run an agent you already have inside the editor, and lend it the editor's DITA tools.
